news.text: #Mateta (currently dealing with a contractual dispute) has always been a striker appreciated by #Spalletti, also for his different characteristics. #Juventus is observing any potential off-field developments. #Mateta has been sounded out by a couple of other clubs.[Alfredo Pedullà]

GJustjuve Exclusive: #Parma, concrete interest and initial dialogues for Daniele #Rugani [Alfredo Pedullà] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71854🇮🇹⚠️ #Parma is looking for at least one defender, #Dossena is on the list, but there is an interest for #Rugani. The latter completed the entire pre-season training camp with #Juventus, he has two more years in his contract, but he is currently evaluating proposals. In recent hours, the emiliano club has evaluated the situation carefully and could press on during this week.[Alfredo Pedullà via @juventusinsidernews]
Exclusive: #Parma, concrete interest and initial dialogues for Daniele #Rugani[Alfredo Pedullà]

GJustjuve .@SSCNapoli is attentive to Adin #Licina from @JuventusFC for the future. [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71851👀 "#Napoli looks toward the future.On the azzurro club's agenda is Adin #Licina, a young talent born in 2007 and currently owned by #Juventus.The player is a long-standing favorite of the azzurro sporting director Giovanni #Manna.The appreciation goes back a long way: even during the time the director worked for #Juve, he had tried to bring him to the bianconeri for the #NextGen when #Licina was still playing in the #BayernMunich youth academy.[@DiMarzio via @PuebloJ]

GJustjuve For @JuventusFC, the name of Alexander #Sørloth in attack still resists. @SkySport [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71850ℹ️❗️"For the striker position, #Sørloth remains at the top of the list. Contacts with #AtléticoMadrid are alive, a swap involving Nico #González is being discussed, but for now an agreement on the formula is missing. The Spaniards would only open to the Argentine's arrival on loan with an option to buy, but at the same time, they would like the Norwegian to leave on a permanent basis. This gap currently is braking everything, even though from now until the end, scenarios and conditions could change."[Di Marzio - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

#Juventus are working to sign a new striker: Aleksandar #Sorloth (Atletico Madrid) and Jean-Philippe #Mateta (Crystal Palace) are #Spalletti’s main targets. Ricky Massara loves Joshua #Zirkzee (Manchester United), but the dutch forward has not the skills demanded by the coach[Nico Schira]
Michele #DiGregorio will wear the no. 20 shirt at #Bournemouth. Expected tomorrow the official statement. #transfers #afcb[Nico Schira]
#CrystalPalace and #AstonVilla have shown interest in #Juventus’ forward Jonathan #David, who is not in #Spalletti’s Plans and can leave #Juve this summer. #transfers[Nico Schira]

🚨 Excl. - Done Deal and confirmed! Michele #DiGregorio has just signed the contract with #Bournemouth until 2031 (1+4) with a salary of 3M/year + bonuses. #afcb sign him from #Juve on loan (2M if they won’t trigger the option to buy) + option to buy (14M + bonuses). #transfers[Nico Schira]
✅‼️Tomorrow could be an important day for #Miretti to #Besiktas.[Mirko Di Natale]

GJustjuve The goalkeeper will arrive from #Wolfsburg on loan with an option to buy [Di Marzio] https://t.me/GJustjuve/71832The player will arrive in Italy for the medical examinations. The operation is a loan with an option to buy based on a total value of 12 million euros. @SkySport[Di Marzio]
Confirmed: Grabara is expected to be in Turin tomorrow ✅⚪️⚫️[Romeo Agresti]

🇮🇹🧐 "#Besiktas has made an official offer for #Miretti: a paid loan with an option to buy, with #Juventus evaluating the numbers and figures. The Turks have had the opportunity to speak directly with him: #Italiano knows him very well. While initially his preference was to look at other leagues, now he has shown openness to this possibility. It remains to be seen if this will lead to definitive agreements."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔜✅ "#Juventus's seventh signing is #Grabara: full agreement has been reached with #Wolfsburg for a loan with an option to buy. There are great chances that he could arrive as early as tomorrow, work is underway to make sure this happens. From the Polish front, they speak of him as the new Yashin."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🙁⁉️ "I sensed a worried atmosphere within #Juventus regarding #Yildiz's foot problem. In the coming hours, he will be evaluated by a specialist and there we will understand everything, including whether surgery will be necessary. The mood is quite negative and there is a feeling that he could be sidelined for a while, but we will have to wait for the official bulletin."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇹🇷🤕 "#Yildiz's injury could be a fracture in his left foot. If confirmed, surgery cannot be ruled out along with a lengthy stop (2/2.5 months). In the immediate aftermath, it didn't bother him, but last night and this morning it started causing him severe pain. Tests have been conducted and we are awaiting official announcements."[Giovanni Guardalà - Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

Curiosity: initially tomorrow morning Mattia #Perin was supposed to undergo the medical examinations for #Palermo at the J Medicals. Instead, Kamil #Grabara is expected there in his place, ready to become the new #Juventus goalkeeper[Nico Schira]

💰 #Perin-#Palermo, the cost of the deal will be slightly below 500k. He will sign a three-year contract until 2029 without an option (as already specified on Friday).✈️ The goalkeeper will undergo his medical examinations tomorrow morning August 25th in Verona and will arrive in the city during the evening.🤝 As stated, the work of agent #Lucci was decisive in unblocking the negotiation. #Juventus initially asked for a 500k paid loan and a 1.5m in bonuses upon achieving the Serie A objective, a demand that has put the negotiation in a stalemate.[Mirko Di Natale]
